title: Parochial schooling and Sister Fabian
summary: He moved to parochial school by choice because it let him make up work around rehearsals, and mentions Sister Fabian.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: want to fill in from that early period? You talked about it early on in our first interview, but I was interested -- was there a church? Did you go to church or anything?
Yes, I attended -- most of my education was received in parochial schools.

And I made that choice -- it was my own choice. I decided that the public school wasn't treating me very thoroughly because I went through such problems every time I had to go to a rehearsal or something. And so I made the move to the parochial school, and it wasn't nearly as difficult.
Yeah, and they allowed me to make up my work and so on.
And one of my teachers in high school, Sister Fabian, who was my reason for having a scholarship fund (inaudible) in Milwaukee.
